audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and whys[5] are shifted one row out of phase with their labels — 'At 5' sits on the Level 6 row and 'Level 6' sits on the First item row.
audit.why: The chart sides are already consistent with the 51.83% win rate over 1588 games and with the packet chart; only the why text is mislabelled, which makes a reader fight in the wrong window.
audit.corrected: Level 6 why keyed to Maximum Dosage and his ult being a roam tool (Skill); First item why keyed to the HP stack (Dr. Mundo).

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere: Winds of War 11/10/9/8/7, Justice Punch 11/10/9/8/7, Shield of Durand 18/17/16/15/14, Hero's Entrance 180/160/140.
audit.why: The entire page says 'trade when his Q is down' and 'bait Justice Punch' without saying how long either window lasts, and his 180s rank-1 ult is why level 6 is a roam threat rather than a duel threat.
audit.corrected: 11s Q and 11s Justice Punch written into the level 3-5 and first-item spikes and the early text.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text and early call Shield of Durand 'purely defensive, not a kill threat'. Riot's text: on release Galio taunts and damages nearby enemies — it is his hard CC and the front half of his all-in. Separately, 'Q sustain' is credited three times; Infected Bonesaw heals nothing. And nothing states that Dr. Mundo has no dash, so Justice Punch can cut off his retreat.
audit.why: Calling his taunt defensive tells you to walk into the one ability that locks you down. The actual interaction is that Dr. Mundo's passive resists the first immobilizing effect — that is the taunt or the knockup, once — and the healing is Heart Zapper's end-of-duration burst, which only heals if it hits.
audit.corrected: Shield of Durand named as a taunt; passive eating the first taunt written in; sustain re-attributed to passive regen and Heart Zapper; Flash reserved for the Justice Punch cut-off, since Mundo has no dash.

notes: Same champion-wide error found on the Cassiopeia, Chogath and Fiora pages: Infected Bonesaw (Q) is repeatedly credited with sustain. It deals current-health damage and slows — the heal is Heart Zapper (W), and only if its end burst lands. Worth a global sweep on drmundo content. Consistent with the mirror audit's note, no resistance-bypass claim was made for Maximum Dosage: it heals, it does not shred.
